title: ContactCard/query args
description: Arguments for ContactCard/query (RFC 9610 §6.4). Returns an ordered list of ContactCard ids matching a filter.

accountId.description: The account to query contact cards from.

filter.description: Filter conditions. Supported properties: inAddressBook (AddressBookId), uid (String), hasMember (String), kind (String), createdBefore/createdAfter (UTCDate), updatedBefore/updatedAfter (UTCDate), text/name/nickname/organization/email/phone/onlineService/address/note (String).

sort.description: Sort criteria. Each Comparator has a property (e.g. nickname, created, updated) and optional isAscending (default true).

position.description: 0-based index of the first result to return.

anchor.description: A ContactCardId to anchor the result page at.

anchorOffset.description: Offset from the anchor (may be negative).

limit.description: Maximum number of ids to return.

calculateTotal.description: If true, return the total number of matching contact cards.
